text_en: I speak Rohingya. I need an interpreter.
scene: A woman at a clinic reception desk with one hand on her chest, the receptionist holding a telephone handset out toward her.
A woman at a clinic reception desk pointing at a wall clock, the receptionist looking at a computer screen.

text_en: I need to see a doctor.
scene: A woman holding her stomach with a pained face, facing a doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope.
A woman holding a small child wrapped in a blanket, the child's cheeks flushed, facing a nurse.
A woman pointing to her lower back with a pained face, a doctor looking on.
A woman in a clinic hallway asking a staff member, who points toward a door marked only with a toilet pictogram.
A woman on a sidewalk asking a passerby, who points toward a bus stop pole with a bus approaching in the distance.
A woman standing at the open front door of a city bus, looking up at the driver with a questioning expression.
A woman at the front of a city bus holding out a few coins on her palm toward the driver.
A woman at the front of a city bus showing the driver a small paper with a simple map and a red location pin drawn on it.
A woman seated near the front of a city bus leaning toward the driver, one hand raised gently.

text_en: What time is the next bus?
scene: A woman at a bus stop tapping her wristwatch while asking another person waiting there.
A woman in a grocery aisle holding up a bag of rice toward a store worker in an apron.
A woman asking a store worker in an apron, who points toward shelves stacked with sacks of rice.
A woman at a grocery meat counter asking the butcher, who holds up a wrapped package of meat with a small green crescent label.
A woman at a grocery checkout with groceries on the belt, gesturing toward a folded paper bag beside the cashier.
A woman at a grocery checkout holding out a few banknotes toward the cashier.
A woman holding a shopping basket asking a store worker, who points toward the checkout lanes.

text_en: I am here for my child.
scene: A woman at a school front office desk, a small child visible waving from a classroom doorway behind.
A woman in a school hallway asking a teacher, who points down the hall toward a classroom door.

text_en: I need to speak to the teacher.
scene: A woman standing at a classroom door, a teacher stepping toward her from beside a chalkboard with no writing on it.
A woman at a school office desk speaking to the secretary, an empty child-sized desk visible through the doorway.
A woman handing an envelope to a teacher, who has opened the letter and is reading it aloud to her.
A woman at a school gate pointing at a round clock on the school wall, a teacher answering her.
